About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel to support corporate legal operations and provide strategic and operational legal guidance across a range of business areas.
In this role, you will work with complex commercial and corporate legal matters, supporting business stakeholders in areas such as corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), strategic collaborations, corporate law and financial law.
You will play an important role in ensuring sound legal decision-making, managing legal risks and supporting business operations in an international environment.
The position also offers opportunities to improve legal operations through more efficient processes and the adoption of legal technology.
Key Responsibilities
Corporate Legal Operations
Support day-to-day corporate legal operations and provide legal guidance to relevant business functions.
Handle and coordinate a broad range of corporate legal matters.
Support business stakeholders in identifying and addressing legal risks.
Provide practical legal recommendations aligned with business objectives and applicable regulations.

Commercial & Corporate Law
Provide legal advice on commercial contracts, business transactions and corporate matters.
Support activities involving corporate governance and corporate law.
Advise on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), business collaborations and strategic partnerships.
Support legal assessments involving financial law and related business activities.
Review and advise on complex legal matters in an international business environment.

Legal Advisory & Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with internal stakeholders and management teams.
Translate complex legal requirements into clear and practical business recommendations.
Support decision-making by identifying legal implications, risks and potential solutions.
Coordinate legal matters involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Ensure that legal guidance supports both operational requirements and long-term business objectives.

Legal Operations & Technology
Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of legal processes.
Support the introduction and use of legal technology solutions.
Contribute to the modernisation of legal operations and working methods.
Promote efficient approaches to legal documentation, workflows and legal service delivery.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Education
Master of Laws (LL.M.) or equivalent recognised legal degree.
A legal qualification from an accredited and recognised educational institution.

Professional Experience
Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience in commercial law.
Strong experience handling complex commercial and corporate legal matters.
Demonstrated ability to provide independent legal advice and practical legal guidance.
Experience working in an international business or corporate environment is highly relevant.
Experience with complex projects and corporate governance is an advantage.

Core Legal Competencies
Commercial Law.
Corporate Governance.
Corporate Law.
Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
Business Collaborations and Strategic Partnerships.
Financial Law.
Legal Risk Assessment and Advisory.

Languages
Professional proficiency in Swedish, both spoken and written.
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written.

Personal Competencies
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
Strong legal judgement and analytical capabilities.
High levels of accountability, ownership and professional integrity.
Ability to independently manage complex legal matters.
Strong business understanding and a practical, solution-oriented approach.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Confidence in advising senior stakeholders and business representatives.
Ability to work effectively in an international and collaborative environment.
Proactive interest in improving legal processes and adopting new technologies.

What We Are Looking For
We are particularly interested in qualified legal professionals with substantial commercial law experience and the ability to support corporate legal operations across multiple business domains.
The ideal candidate combines strong legal expertise with commercial awareness, sound judgement and the ability to translate complex legal issues into practical business solutions.
Experience in M&A, corporate governance, international commercial agreements and legal technology initiatives will be especially valuable.

Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
In the research subject Applied Geochemistry at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering, Luleå University of Technology (LTU), we are looking for a Postdoc Researcher. Applied Geochemistry at LTU focuses on the occurrence and mobility of elements and geochemical processes that occur in rock, soil, and water at the Earth’s surface. Research is conducted on natural and anthropogenic sources and their interactions within and between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere. This is achieved by combining analytical chemistry, isotopic geochemistry, environmental forensics, and environmental mineralogy. Research and education in this subject address environmental issues tied to the mining industry, infrastructure construction, acid sulphate soils, and sulphide-bearing rocks. The research group has a strong experimental and applied profile, with well-equipped laboratories and extensive collaborations with industry and the public sector, all geared towards building a long-term, sustainable society.
Subject description
Applied Geochemistry is concerned with studies into the occurrence and mobility of the elements in rocks, soil, and water, focusing on methods to prevent or reduce the environmental impact of metal extraction and infrastructure development.
Background
The position will support the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet) funded PhD Research School on Mining and Mineral Research – BioGeoMetals, a national collaboration between Linnaeus University (coordinator), Luleå University of Technology (LTU), and KTH Royal Institute of Technology. BioGeoMetals focuses on biogeochemical and hydrogeochemical approaches for sustainable metal recovery and environmental management in mining environments. The research school addresses the mobilization and recovery of critical raw materials from mining waste rock, tailings, groundwater, or run-off waters, as well as bioremediation of impacted mine sites. Through interdisciplinary doctoral training, joint courses, and close collaboration with industry and public authorities, the research school aims to educate the next generation of researchers contributing to sustainable mining and responsible resource management in Sweden and beyond.
Project description
The project will investigate how microbiology can be used in geochemical exploration to find ore deposits. Characterisation of solids, liquids and microbes in mining environments (e.g. tailings, mine water, and waste rock) will serve as the base for subsequent brown- and greenfield exploration trials. The successful candidate will focus on the characterisation of solids and closely work with the PhDs and partners in the project.
The work will cover:- Laboratory and field investigations- Mineralogical, geochemical and petrographic characterization- Development of analytical methods and exploration strategies
Duties
As a Postdoc, you will:
- Conduct field sampling of solid phases (rock, soil, till, sediments)
- Perform laboratory-based geochemical and mineralogical analyses
- Integrate and interpret multi-disciplinary datasets
- Design methods of mineral exploration
- Co-supervise PhD's
- Teach in geology-related courses
- Publish results in peer-reviewed scientific journals
- Present findings at national and international conferences
Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in exploration, geochemistry, field and laboratory work, microbiology, and sustainable mining.
You must have:
- A PhD degree in geology, geochemistry, environmental geoscience, or a closely related field
- Good oral and written proficiency in English
- Experience in conducting field work
- Expertise in soil-related exploration
- Strong background in characterisation techniques
- A driving license
Meritorious qualifications include:
- SEM-based automated mineralogy
- Heavy mineral concentration expertise
Personal qualities such as analytical ability, independence, collaboration skills, and strong motivation for research will be given significant weight.
Further information 
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension. The position is based in Luleå. Start date: January 2027 or according to agreement.
For each position, a preliminary salary range https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.
For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Thomas Aiglsperger, +46 920-491016, thomas.aiglsperger@ltu.se, or Oscar Paulsson oscar.paulsson@ltu.se

jobs.occupation: Marketing Specialist - Life Science Content & Campaigns
jobs.description:
About the Job 
Join Symcel’s Sales and Marketing team as our new Marketing Specialist and help bring advanced instruments to researchers, laboratories and pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide. 
We are looking for a creative, proactive and hands-on marketer with a strong life science background, excellent content creation skills and the ability to independently manage marketing projects from concept to completion. 
In this role, you will take ownership of content development, graphic design, video production, digital marketing activities, webinars and events, working closely with colleagues across Sales, Product Management and Applications. 
If you enjoy transforming complex scientific information into engaging, commercially relevant content and want to make a real impact in a growing international life science company, we'd love to hear from you. 

About Symcel 
Symcel is a Swedish life science company in an exciting commercial scale-up phase, with an international team of scientists, engineers and business professionals. 
Our innovative biocalorimetry-based systems use highly sensitive isothermal microcalorimetry to detect and analyze biological activity. Our instruments supports applications ranging from rapid sterility testing of advanced therapies and pharmaceuticals to microbial testing, biofilm analysis and biological research. 
We are united by a mission to support researchers and manufacturers develop, test and deliver life-changing treatments and products. 
Our company language is English. 
Discover more about us at symcel.com. 

Job description 
As a Marketing Specialist, you will plan, create and execute marketing activities across digital channels, scientific content, video, webinars and events. 
This is a hands-on role where you will independently manage projects from gathering scientific input and writing content to designing materials, publishing and distribution. 
You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Product Management, Applications and Sales while taking ownership of your own projects and deliverables. 
The position is based at Symcel's head office on the Karolinska Institutet campus in Stockholm, with the option to work remotely 1–2 days per week. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Independently writing high-quality scientific and marketing content, including website copy, blog articles, case studies, brochures, presentations and sales materials. 
Designing and producing marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, images, presentations and exhibition materials. 
Creating and editing video content, including product videos, interviews and short videos for digital channels and social media. 
Planning and producing webinars, including speaker coordination, recording, editing and promotion. 
Developing and managing digital marketing activities across channels such as social media, email, website and Google Ads. 
Managing and updating website content, ensuring SEO and AI search optimization, good user experience and alignment with brand guidelines. 
Coordinating Symcel’s participation in exhibitions and scientific conferences, including event planning, logistics and promotional materials. 

 
Qualifications 
We believe the ideal candidate combines a solid scientific understanding with strong communication skills, creative production capabilities and the ability to independently manage marketing activities. 

Required qualifications: 
Academic degree in life sciences, such as microbiology, biotechnology, biomedicine or a closely related discipline. 
At least 3 years of professional experience in marketing, content creation or scientific communication, including experience within the life science industry, diagnostics or laboratory instrumentation industries. 
Proven experience independently writing and producing high-quality scientific, technical and marketing content in English. 
Hands-on experience in graphic design and layout, with proficiency in tools such as Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Canva or equivalent. 
Hands-on experience creating and editing video content for marketing purposes. 
Experience working with digital marketing channels, including website content, email marketing and social media. 
Proven ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into engaging marketing content and independently manage projects from concept to final delivery. 
Excellent written and spoken English. 

Why join us? 
At Symcel, you’ll join a growing life science company with a collaborative, international and positive work environment. Our technology is helping improve solutions for medical treatments and patient care, enabling faster and more efficient quality control in areas such as cell and gene therapy. 
You’ll be part of an agile, engaged team where your contributions truly matter and where you’ll have the opportunity to grow, take initiative and help shape how we bring our solutions to the global market. 
 
Contact & Application 
We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis and are eager to fill this position. We encourage applications from candidates already based in the Stockholm region. 
To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to careers@symcel.com, using “Marketing Specialist” as the email subject line.

Please include examples or links to marketing materials you have personally created, demonstrating your experience in scientific content creation, graphic design and video production. 
 
Application deadline: 2027-01-10 
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Loving and Experienced DAYTIME Nanny Wanted for a Wonderful Little Boy
jobs.description:
Ref. 4298Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced daytime nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine love for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has a permanent back injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. Having a nanny available whenever he is with his mother is therefore essential. The role involves supporting both the child and the family in everyday life.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Day Nanny – Responsibilities
The role combines childcare with light household support.
While he is at nursery, approximately 2–5 hours will generally be spent on household tasks. The nanny should remain available in case he is unwell, nursery is closed or plans change.
Responsibilities include:
Morning routines, breakfast and preparing meals and snacks.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing, engaging and supporting his interests and activities.
Preparing healthy meals for the family.
Laundry, ironing and making beds.
Keeping the child's areas tidy and cleaning up after him.
Wiping kitchen surfaces and general light household tasks.
Administering medication when required.

The family particularly appreciates someone who enjoys cooking and takes initiative in the kitchen. A weekly cleaner is employed.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.
Enjoys cooking and preparing family meals.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
The family is looking for someone who genuinely cares about his happiness and development and brings warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!
Location: Östermalm, Stockholm
Start date: November 2026 – January 2027 (TBC)
Schedule: Every other week
Working hours: 08:00–20:00 (±1 hour)
Child: One boy, 4.5 years old
Languages: English preferred
Position: Long-term, full-time employment

Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.

Om Nordic Light Nannies:
Vi söker nu en ny medarbetare som vill ha nanny som sitt yrke. Vi arbetar mot familjer som ställer höga krav på kvalitet när de väljer en nanny. De flesta av våra tjänster är på minst halvtid och vi tycker det är väldigt viktigt att även nannyn trivs bra ihop med familjen. Därför tar vi dina önskemål på stort allvar när vi presenterar familjer för dig.
Vi har Sveriges bästa villkor för nannies med bland annat sjuklön och semesterersättning.
Lönerna bestäms individuellt beroende på erfarenhet och utbildning och är jämförbara med förskollärare lön i Stockholm. Minimilön 150 kr/tim. Vi kan erbjuda högre lön upp till 210 kr/tim för nannies med mycket erfarenhet och/eller pedagogisk utbildning. Fasta månadslöner förekommer inom vissa tjänster.
Läs mer på https://nordiclightnannies.se/lediga-tjanster/
Har du kunskap och erfarenhet inom barns utveckling?
Gillar du att leka och hitta på olika saker ute och inne? Då är detta rätt jobb för dig!
Har du:
Minst tre års erfarenhet av professionellt arbete med barn (intyg/dokumentation och referenser krävs) eller motsvarande kompetens?
Ett intresse för att arbeta med barn och deras utveckling?
Pedagogisk utbildning så som förskollärare, barnskötare, lärare, fritidspedagog, dramapedagog etc. är meriterande, likaså körkort!

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer  BEV Chassis Integration
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration | CATIA V5
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Mechanical Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration
Specialisation: Mechanical Design | Chassis Integration | Sheet Metal Design | Pneumatic Systems | CATIA V5
Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Work Model: On-site (100%)
Assignment Period: 1 December 2026 – 29 December 2028
Language: English
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to contribute to the development and integration of components and systems for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) chassis solutions.
You will work on mechanical design, component integration and installation solutions within heavy-duty vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on sheet metal components, brackets, pneumatic systems and chassis packaging.
The role involves working with advanced CAD tools, developing detailed 3D and 2D designs, coordinating with suppliers and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver technically robust and production-ready solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Mechanical Design & Component Development
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis applications.
Develop sheet metal components, brackets and mounting solutions.
Design and integrate pneumatic components and installation systems.
Create detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and technical requirements.
Perform tolerance analysis and ensure dimensional accuracy.

2. Chassis Integration & Component Packaging
Work with component packaging, interfaces and installation requirements.
Ensure effective integration of mechanical and pneumatic components within vehicle chassis architectures.
Evaluate installation space, clearances, interfaces and mounting requirements.
Develop practical design solutions considering functionality, manufacturability and serviceability.
Support the integration of components within electric vehicle chassis platforms.

3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the design and development lifecycle.
Participate in technical discussions, design reviews and engineering coordination activities.
Support supplier interactions and resolve technical design-related challenges.
Coordinate design requirements and ensure alignment across relevant stakeholders.

4. Verification, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Support design reviews, validation activities and technical investigations.
Prepare and maintain engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
Support manufacturing and production-related activities when required.
Contribute to design optimization, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant mechanical design engineering experience.
Previous R&D experience with Scania/Hero or the relevant TRATON organization is mandatory.
Strong practical experience in one or more of the following areas:
Sheet metal design and development.
Brackets and mechanical installation solutions.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Component packaging and chassis integration.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D engineering drawings.
Experience with tolerance analysis and dimensional engineering.
Good understanding of component interfaces, packaging and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing and manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic and/or pneumatic components.
Ability to develop practical and technically sound mechanical design solutions.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience in the following areas will be highly advantageous:
Heavy-duty vehicle chassis design and integration.
Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) development.
Truck chassis component integration and installation.
Sheet metal component design and manufacturing.
Pneumatic system design and integration.
Supplier coordination and technical design reviews.
Vehicle packaging, mounting interfaces and tolerance management.
Production support and engineering documentation.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a proactive and technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer who can independently drive design activities and contribute to complex vehicle integration projects.
The ideal candidate should have practical experience in heavy-duty vehicle development, strong CATIA V5 capabilities and a solid understanding of mechanical design principles.
You should be comfortable collaborating with suppliers, engineering teams and other stakeholders while taking ownership of technical deliverables, solving design challenges and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
Important Information
Previous R&D experience with the specified heavy-duty vehicle OEM/group is mandatory.
The position is 100% on-site in Södertälje.
CV must be submitted in English.
A background check will be conducted before the start of the employment/assignment.
Candidate selection will take place continuously.
There may be opportunities for an extension beyond the stated period.

jobs.description:
Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med kollegor från hela världen?

Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad personal som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever.

Nu söker vi dig som vill vara en del av oss på Internationella Engelska Skolan i Halmstad och som vill arbeta i det viktiga uppdraget som elevassistent. Vi söker dig med erfarenhet från liknande tjänst, som är lung, stresstålig och engagerad - gärna med relevant utbildning. Du har förmåga att kunna anpassa ditt förhållningssätt och dina pedagogiska metoder utifrån elevens skiftande behov. Det är viktigt att du är prestigelös, flexibel och trivs i en föränderlig miljö. Du är väl införstådd i skolans styrdokument och har alltid elevens bästa i fokus. Du planerar och organiserar ditt arbete effektivt och är mån om att skapa och underhålla goda relationer med såväl elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du medverkar till en elev som är i behov av särskilt stöd får ett individanpassat och inkluderande bemötande samt riktade insatser som syftar till ökad måluppfyllelse.

Som elevassistent hos oss arbetar man i ett nära samarbete med ansvarig grundskollärare och specialpedagoger. Du arbetar med en eller flera elever som behöver extra stöd för att kunna följa med i undervisningen. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter handlar därför om att hjälpa eleverna att följa med i undervisningen och hjälpa dem med att finna ro i sina studier. Utöver det kan dina arbetsuppgifter också bestå av att hjälpa eleverna att träna på olika vardagsuppgifter, vara ett stöd för eleverna på raster och på utflykter.

Anställningen är på heltid t o m slutet av VT-26.

Stockholm International School is a non-profit foundation that caters to the Stockholm Diplomatic community, government, banks and industry.

Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

In charge of entrance security at drop-off and pick-up 
Patrol of the grounds and buildings 
Keep all buildings safe and secure from intruders and threats 
Accompany staff and students on field trips, museums, sports days and other special events
Escort students between school buildings

Overview all locations on CCTV

Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish
Training in security or close protection.

Specialpedagog (vikariat)

Vi söker nu en engagerad och drivande specialpedagog för ett vikariat. Du tror att varje elev kan och har möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential, och du hjälper gärna lärare att skapa förutsättningar för differentiering och individuella anpassningar där det behövs. Du brinner för alla elevers rätt att lära och är intresserad av att ta del av den senaste forskningen kring lärande samt bidra till att implementera den i verksamheten.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en dynamisk och multikulturell miljö med kollegor från hela världen.

Vem är du?

- Du är utbildad specialpedagog med erfarenhet av att arbeta i grundskolan, gärna på mellan- och högstadiet
- Du är flytande i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska
- Du har kunskap om och delar Internationella Engelska Skolans värderingar och ethos
- Du brinner för skolutveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att:

- Kartlägga och utreda elevers behov av särskilt stöd
- Upprätta åtgärdsprogram baserat på utredningarna
- Ansvara för kontakter kring elever med externa aktörer (t.ex. BUP, habiliteringen och socialtjänsten)
- Handleda lärare i specialpedagogik
- Delta i elevhälsans arbete för alla elevers bästa

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Hos oss är studiero viktigt, vilket kräver att du är trygg i din roll och har förmågan att skapa ett gott arbetsklimat för både elever och kollegor.

Du är en lagspelare med hög arbetsmoral som trivs i en internationell skolmiljö. Vidare har du god förmåga att kommunicera och samverka med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare, samt en vilja att vara med och utveckla vår skola.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 100 % med start så snart som möjligt och pågår till och med den 28 januari. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

It’s a Tuesday afternoon. You just closed your laptop after an awesome shift with a kick-ass team. 10 minutes later, you’re at a beach bar with a cold drink, soak up 25°C sunshine, and plan a weekend catamarans trip around the Blue Lagoon.
If your current routine involves grey skies, wet commutes, and endless coffee refills just to survive the winter—this is your sign to make a move.

Requirements

Proven Support Experience (Non-Negotiable): You already have hands-on experience in a customer service environment (call center, contact center, or BPO live chat). You know how to multitask, handle chat queues, and deliver 5-star support under pressure.

Ready to Upgrade Your Life?
Don't let another rainy season pass you by. Grab your CV, highlight your call center/customer service experience, and hit apply today!
Submit your CV in English and kickstart your Mediterranean career chapter!

You will provide business-minded legal advice and manage legal matters across IT and digital. Your responsibilities will include supporting smart home product development, negotiating and drafting agreements, participating in IT sourcing activities, and helping the business meet digital compliance requirements, including those under the EU AI Act, NIS2 and GDPR.  
You will belong to the Legal & Governance function at IKEA of Sweden AB and report to the General Counsel and Head of Legal & Governance, Range.

Our organization requires and values great self-discipline and a natural talent to make things happen, create relationships, and co-operate with people from different backgrounds. You are fluent in English (Swedish is a bonus).  
We offer a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where we both give and take responsibility. You will have the chance to grow with us professionally and individually. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with and support stakeholders and colleagues as well as share your knowledge with people in a global and dynamic context.

A Degree of Master of Laws from a reputable University. 

At least 7 years of relevant professional experience from a business law firm and/or as an in-house legal counsel in an international legal or business environment.

Does this sound like the right position for you? Send us your application today!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Skolkurator till IES Örebro

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Örebro startade i augusti 2003 och är i dag en grundskola för årskurserna 4–9 med cirka 620 elever. Vi grundar vår verksamhet på en trygg och studiefrämjande skolmiljö, tvåspråkig undervisning samt höga akademiska förväntningar.

Att arbeta hos oss innebär att du blir en del av ett starkt professionellt och kollegialt sammanhang. Vårt elevhälsoteam (EHT) består av biträdande rektor, speciallärare, specialpedagog, skolsköterska, kurator, socialpedagog samt skolpsykolog och skolläkare.

Vi söker nu en engagerad och drivande skolkurator på heltid för årskurserna 4–9. Som skolkurator arbetar du förebyggande och hälsofrämjande på individ-, grupp- och skolnivå för att undanröja hinder för lärande och utveckling. Du gillar att  jobba lika mycket i skolans korridorer som på ditt kontor med normbrytande beteende och elever i behov av extra stöd.

Du ingår i skolans Trygghetsteam och i uppdraget ingår även att undervisa i livskunskap. 

Kvalifikationer och profil

- Socionomexamen 
- Dokumenterad kunskap och erfarenhet av psykosocialt och stödjande arbete med barn och ungdomar.
- Erfarenhet av samverkan med externa aktörer såsom BUP, socialtjänst  och andra relevanta instanser.
- Hög förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ, kombinerat med god samarbetsförmåga.
- Mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan den sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan så snart som möjligt!Vi erbjuder

- En varierad och utvecklande roll i en internationell skolmiljö.
- Stor möjlighet att påverka och göra reell skillnad för elevernas skolgång och mående.
- En dynamisk arbetsplats med daglig kontakt med elever, personal, föräldrar och besökare.
- Engagerade, stöttande och kompetenta kollegor.
- Möjlighet att aktivt bidra till skolans fortsatta utveckling och kvalitet.
- En stark skolkultur präglad av lärande, ömsesidig respekt, gemenskap och höga ambitioner.

Om anställningen

Anställningen avser en heltidstjänst (100 %). Tillträde den 7 januari 2027.  Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.

För anställning krävs ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete inom skola och förskola.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.occupation: Taxiförare till Uber, Bolt och friåkning – hela Stockholm
jobs.description:
Meebuz Liners AB söker fem taxiförare till Stockholm

Vi är ett växande taxiföretag i Stockholmsområdet som kör uppdrag via Uber och Bolt samt egna körningar (friåkning). Vår fordonsflotta består av moderna hybrid- och elbilar, samtliga godkända för att hämta och lämna passagerare på Arlanda Airport. Nu utökar vi verksamheten och söker fem engagerade förare.

VIKTIGT: TAXIFÖRARLEGITIMATION ÄR ETT KRAV
Du måste ha en giltig taxiförarlegitimation, utfärdad av Transportstyrelsen, redan när du söker tjänsten. Ange numret på din taxiförarlegitimation i ansökan. Ansökningar utan detta nummer går vi tyvärr inte vidare med.

OM TJÄNSTEN
Du kör persontransport i hela Stockholms län, både uppdrag via Uber och Bolt och egna kunder. Arbetsplatsen är hela Stockholm, med goda möjligheter till flygplatskörningar till och från Arlanda.

Heltid, tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning
Fria arbetstider, du väljer själv när du kör, dag eller natt
Fast och rörlig lön

VI SÖKER DIG SOM
har giltig taxiförarlegitimation utfärdad av Transportstyrelsen (krav)
har B-körkort (krav)
kan kommunicera på grundläggande svenska med kunder och myndigheter, flytande svenska är inget krav
kan engelska, som du använder med resenärer och i apparna för Uber och Bolt
har god lokalkännedom i Stockholm, eller är snabb att lära dig
är serviceinriktad, punktlig och har ett professionellt bemötande
kör trafiksäkert och tar ansvar för fordonet

Erfarenhet av taxi, Uber eller Bolt är meriterande, men vi lägger störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

VI ERBJUDER
Fria arbetstider, du planerar själv dina körpass
Nya hybrid- och elbilar
Arlanda-behörighet på samtliga fordon
Trygg anställning i ett företag som växer
Ett öppet arbetsklimat där du alltid får stöd av oss

SÅ ANSÖKER DU
Skicka din ansökan med CV till meebuzliners@hotmail.com. Ange "Taxiförare Stockholm" i ämnesraden och skriv numret på din taxiförarlegitimation i ansökan. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsterna kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med att söka.

Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Shahid Iqbal på 070-438 79 03.

IN ENGLISH
Meebuz Liners AB is hiring five taxi drivers for the Stockholm area. We operate through Uber, Bolt and our own customers, using modern hybrid and electric vehicles, all approved for pick-up and drop-off at Arlanda Airport. You choose your own working hours, day or night. A valid taxi driver licence (taxiförarlegitimation) issued by Transportstyrelsen and a category B driving licence are required. Basic Swedish is enough, fluent Swedish is not required, and English is used with passengers and in the Uber and Bolt apps. Full-time permanent position with fixed and variable pay. Please state the number of your taxiförarlegitimation in your application, applications without it will not be processed. Apply by email to meebuzliners@hotmail.com.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.
